metadata.description: Gruntas for Claude Code and Codex: orchestration for autonomous agents. See every session on every machine, hand work to a machine with room, and publish evidence of the work as permalinks.

plugins.name: gruntas
plugins.description: Gruntas agent orchestration for Claude Code: every session registers with the gruntas daemon, reports its status, and gets the gruntas MCP server (status, publishing, delegation) and skill. Hooks run the gruntas on your PATH, else nothing.
